# `returning-released-value`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: warning · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports a returned owning value that is released by a defer as the function
exits.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

The caller receives an allocation that has already been freed or destroyed.

## When it fires

It applies when the return binding and deferred release target are the same
mechanically identified value.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const std = @import("std");

fn make(allocator: std.mem.Allocator) ![]u8 {
    const buf = try allocator.alloc(u8, 8);
    defer allocator.free(buf);
    return buf;
}
```
